notes.title: "Gaokao Love 100 Days" 10th Anniversary Short Story Release!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the players who have continuously supported the Class Tangerine.
Our new work, "Bagel Love Story" is now available!

This new release is set in the same universe as "Gaokao Love 100 Days",
 with the timeline placed 10 years after the original story.
The game will feature cameo appearances from characters in "Gaokao Love 100 Days" and even "Bunny e-Shop".

 How many Easter eggs can you find?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2798600/Bagel_Love_Story/

* Currently the game is only available in Chinese, please wishlist it if you're interested.

notes.title: Revised English Subtitle & "War Within Pilgrimagers"[Update 655423]
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]

Item "War Within Pilgrimagers" now can be successfully acquired at END 41.

If you have unlocked END 41 before, please check the ending in the end-list and get the item to unlock the achievement.

修复“真·西游杀”无法获得的问题，现在可以在结局41获得此道具。假如之前已经解锁过结局41，请在结局列表里重温，即可获得道具（解锁成就）~

[h1]Revised English Subtitle[/h1]

Many thanks to our proofreaders, a better English version is online now!

英文校正版上线，各位校对君辛苦了！

[h1]Savedata error after update (can be fixed manually)[/h1]

Since there are lots of changes in the English subtitle, part of the save data could become invalid after the new update. (English Language Only).

It will only affect the data saved during events. The data saved at “Night Class Mode” and “Weekend Free Mode” will remain the same. The CGs/Endings/Achievements/Items will also work as usual. 

[b]The save data can be fixed and then be used in the new version after the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347620/discussions/0/598198173700400399/]following steps[/url].[/b]

We are sorry for the inconvenient. ːmuxinː

少部分英文版的存档可能会在更新之后出现无法正常读取的现象，请按[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347620/discussions/0/598198173700400399/]此步骤[/url]修复，即可在新版本继续游戏。
